semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company is involved in the resale and maintenance of semiconductor fabrication, test, and assembly equipment, which are critical components in the semiconductor manufacturing process.
summary: Advance Process Technology, Inc. specializes in the buying and selling of used semiconductor fabrication, test, and assembly equipment. The company also provides technical support, refurbishment, and installation services for selected tools, enhancing the lifecycle and efficiency of semiconductor manufacturing processes.
capabilities: Resale of used semiconductor fabrication equipment
Technical support for semiconductor manufacturing tools
